description: Red color channel intensity. Crucial for detecting active bleeding, erythema, and vascular lesions (angiectasia).
Green color channel intensity. Key for mucosal boundary contrast and structural tissue texture delineation.
Blue color channel intensity. Absorbed strongly by hemoglobin; aids depth estimation and bile distinction.
Low-level Gabor edge detectors, color gradients, texture primitives (Frozen pre-trained weights).
Intermediate motif and textural junction representations (Frozen pre-trained weights).
High-level anatomical shape parts, mucosal folding patterns (Fine-tuned).
Diagnostic pathology semantics (ulcer crater, vascular ectasia clusters). Source layer for Grad-CAM explainability.
Unnormalized class scores mapping to 5 target diagnostic categories.
